findings.title: Ready pods are held unavailable by minReadySeconds
findings.cause: Deployment web has 2 of 2 pods ready but only 0 available: its minReadySeconds is 3600, so a pod counts as available only after it has stayed ready for 1h0m0s, and a rollout waits that long at every step

evidence.what: Deployment web has minReadySeconds 3600, 2 ready and 0 available
evidence.command: kubectl get deployment web -n kd-min-ready-seconds -o jsonpath='{.spec.minReadySeconds}{" "}{.status.readyReplicas}{" "}{.status.availableReplicas}'

findings.fix: Lower minReadySeconds to the few seconds a new pod needs to prove itself (it is not a timeout), and let the readiness probe say when the pod can serve.
